nodes.question: How many OTUs were classified as specialists, and how many phyla did they represent?
nodes.answer: A total of 159 OTUs were classified as specialists, representing a set of 22 diverse phyla.
nodes.paragraph: 4a). A total of 201OTUs representing 10 phyla were classi ed as abundant taxa (Sup- plementary Fig. 4b). Based on the enrichment analysis, Actinobacteria, Acidobacteria, and Nitrospirae were signi cantly enriched among abundant taxa ( P< 0.5 for all; Fig. 1e). A total of 870 OTUs repre- senting 26 phyla were classi ed as rare taxa (Supplementary Fig. 4c), and among them, 7 phyla were signi cantly enriched, includingGemmatimonadetes, Bacteroidetes, Chloro exi, Planctomycetes, Armatimonadetes, Chlorobi, and TM6 ( P< 0.5 for all; Fig. 1e). A total of 156 OTUs representing 10 phyla were classi ed as generalists (Supplementary Fig. 4d), and among them, Actinobacteria andNitrospirae were signi cantly enriched ( P< 0.5 for both; Fig. 1e). A similar number of OTUs (159) were classi ed as specialists, but they represented a set of more diverse phyla (22) compared to generalists(Supplementary Fig. 4e).
